title: Sending a diet plan, a workout plan or saving measurements never says who will not get the phone pop-up
what: When the owner sends a diet plan or workout plan, or saves a member's body measurements, the member's phone gets a pop-up only if the member's app number matches the gym list, the first name matches, no other member on the list shares that mobile (families), and the member kept 'Messages from my gym' on. The screen only says members see it 'after they check in at the gym once'. A wife and husband on one mobile, or a member whose app name differs, silently get no pop-up, and the owner thinks it went.
expected: The send sheet and the measurement card say a pop-up goes to the member's phone, and say plainly when this member will not get one and why (no app yet, number shared with another member, name does not match, pop-ups off).
how_often: every send to a member who shares a mobile, has a different app name or turned pop-ups off
fix_line: Show on the send sheet whether this member will get a pop-up, and the reason when not

title: The 'Using the app' tag on the member page follows a different rule from the one that decides who gets pop-ups
what: The member page shows 'Using the app' only for members with a saved app link. Pop-ups and gym news reach members by a second rule (same check-in mobile and first name). At Crispy Curves no member of 2 carries the app link, so the tag shows for nobody, while 1 of 2 members has joined in the app with a check-in mobile. The owner cannot tell from the member page who will get the gym's pop-ups.
expected: One rule decides both the tag and who gets pop-ups, so 'Using the app' means 'this member gets your app messages'.
fix_line: Drive the 'Using the app' tag from the same check the pop-ups use

title: Every small edit to a diet plan sends all its members another 'Your gym changed your diet plan' pop-up
what: Each save that changes a diet plan's words, meals or numbers sends a fresh pop-up to every member on that plan. An owner who fixes three typos in a row sends every member three pop-ups. The edit screen gives no warning that saving will ping members.
expected: Edits close together send at most one pop-up, or the owner chooses whether to tell members, and the screen says a pop-up will go.
fix_line: Group edits made within a few minutes into one pop-up, and say on Save that members will be told

title: Pop-ups to members from a new challenge, diet plan or measurement go out at any hour
what: A challenge or diet plan saved late at night pops up on members' phones within a minute, even at 11:30 pm. There are no quiet hours for these member pop-ups.
expected: Pop-ups made at night wait until morning (for example 7 am India time).
fix_line: Hold member pop-ups made between 10 pm and 7 am until 7 am
